title: Zesty Pillowy Ukrainian Eggs Flatbread
description: A garlicky, pillowy Ukrainian dish perfect for brunch, featuring red pepper paste and double-rise bread.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, salt, sugar in a mixing bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add eggs, red pepper paste, and chopped garlic. Mix until a sticky dough develops.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough, divide it into 4 equal pieces, and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Heat a non-stick skillet or teppan over medium-high heat. Brush the skillet with olive oil.
Cook the flatbreads for 1-2 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and puffed.
Brush the flatbreads with unsalted butter and top with chopped fresh dill.
Serve the flatbreads immediately, hot from the skillet.
